prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: ARDmag editorial hero, 16:9
Primary request: an original, premium, technically accurate workshop photograph of a dry-fit mitered stone corner before glue. Exactly two short rigid natural-stone rectangular samples: one horizontal sample ends in a true 45-degree bevel and one vertical sample ends in its complementary true 45-degree bevel. Their full bevel planes touch flush and create exactly one crisp convex 90-degree L-shaped exterior corner. A craftsperson holds the two samples together so the bevel faces make full flush contact and the outer faces form exactly one crisp 90-degree convex L-shaped corner.
Scene/backdrop: credible professional stone workshop in Romania, subdued and softly defocused. Empty workbench occupies the left 45% and lower-left quadrant.
Subject and hand placement: place the compact L-shaped samples near x=0.55. Show two small complete hands belonging to one worker, both seen from fingertips through wrists. The upper hand is immediately above the joint and holds the short horizontal sample; the lower hand is immediately below the joint and holds the short vertical sample. Hands face inward toward each other and do not overlap the seam.
Style/medium: premium documentary editorial photography, realistic natural skin and stone, credible camera optics, not CGI, no staged catalog feel.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9, slightly wider camera distance, front-left oblique view. Central-right compact action, large clean negative space left and bottom-left. Must remain complete in a central 9:16 crop and shallow 21:9 crop.
Lighting/mood: controlled soft workshop daylight, warm earth tones with subtle terracotta and amber.
Materials/textures: honed beige limestone, rigid straight 20 mm pieces, crisp intact edges, dry clean faces, realistic contact shadows.
Constraints: exactly two rigid pieces and two 45-degree mating faces; true full contact and exact 90-degree corner; dry-fit only; hands merely align; anatomically correct hands, five fingers each, realistic grip; coherent perspective, scale, thickness, shadows. No text, logos, watermark, labels, products, packaging, UI or tools.
Avoid: adhesive, mastic, glue, paste, liquid, application, clamps, saw, polishing; no gap, black void, overlap, double seam or edge, extra fragment or layer, material bridge, melted, bent or warped stone, floating sample, deformed, extra, fused or cropped fingers.
